title: Dynamic weighted group summaries with tidy evaluation
category: non-standard evaluation; literal column names; grouping semantics
source: Original task from R_Knowledge_MCP_Hard_Benchmark_v1.md (H01). Inspired in spirit by challenging tidyverse questions such as vitals::are (https://vitals.tidyverse.org/reference/are.html); no third-party prompt, solution or verifier is reproduced.
difficulty_hypothesis: Typical solutions filter invalid rows before grouping (losing all-invalid groups), let 0/0 produce NaN, keep an input's existing grouping or return a grouped result, turn names into code (parse_expr) or collide with the .data/.env pronouns, and sum integer weights in integer arithmetic.
expected_mcp_relevance: Moderate: dplyr/rlang Rd for pick(), across(all_of()), arrange(.locale), summarise(.groups) and the .data/.env pronouns is available through get_function_docs; the core difficulty is reasoning about edge cases.
setup_prerequisites: Scorer and executor images contain R 4.5.2 with dplyr, rlang, tibble, vctrs, callr and testthat matching configs/renv.lock; no network or package installation.
